name: Siphon
author: Wian Schoeman
description: Which app is eating your bandwidth, live in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Per-application upload and download rates, ranked worst first, so you can see what is draining a tethered or metered connection.

schema.label: Text beside the icon
schema.description: Show the combined rate, download only, or the name of the heaviest app. Vertical bars stay icon-only.

schema.label: Sample interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often per-process traffic is re-sampled.

schema.label: Warn above (Mbps)
schema.description: Notify when a single app sustains more than this. Zero disables the warning.
